findings.text: the 30-second advance is not itself asserted: setting _PARITY_CLOCK_ADVANCE to timedelta(0) makes _hold_the_budget_clock_at pin both calls of a pair to one instant, so the parity case still passes and the drop it makes necessary stops being exercised, leaving the determinism this node adds unguarded
